Questions collected across this library.

notes.title: Spectral theorem
notes.markdown:
# Spectral theorem

A real symmetric matrix has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors.

## Consequence

Orthogonal diagonalization preserves lengths and angles.

notes.title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues
notes.markdown:
# Eigenvectors

An eigenvector keeps its direction when a linear transformation is applied. The eigenvalue is its scale factor.

notes.title: Acid-base titration
notes.markdown:
# Equivalence point

A titration determines an unknown concentration. At equivalence the acid and base are present in stoichiometric proportions.

notes.title: Photosynthesis
notes.markdown:
# Light reactions

Chlorophyll captures photons and the thylakoid membrane builds a proton gradient.

# Calvin cycle

Rubisco fixes carbon dioxide into organic molecules.

notes.title: Mitosis
notes.markdown:
# Metaphase

Chromosomes align at the metaphase plate before sister chromatids separate during anaphase.

notes.title: Habeas corpus
notes.markdown:
# Judicial review of detention

A habeas corpus petition asks a court to examine whether a person's detention is lawful.

notes.title: Consideration in contract law
notes.markdown:
# Bargained exchange

Consideration is the value exchanged between parties and is generally required for an enforceable common-law contract.

notes.title: Price elasticity of demand
notes.markdown:
# Elasticity

Price elasticity measures the percentage change in quantity demanded divided by the percentage change in price.

notes.title: French Revolution
notes.markdown:
# Estates-General

The fiscal crisis led Louis XVI to summon the Estates-General in 1789. The Third Estate then declared a National Assembly.

notes.title: Théorème de Fubini
notes.markdown:
# Intégrales itérées

Le théorème de Fubini permet d'échanger l'ordre des intégrales lorsque les hypothèses d'intégrabilité sont satisfaites.

notes.title: Oxidation and reduction
notes.markdown:
# Electron transfer

Oxidation loses electrons while reduction gains electrons. The oxidizing agent is itself reduced.
